# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The user does not want "AI Cloud Proxy/Package.appxmanifest" (Package.appxmanifest) or "Package.StoreAssociation.xml" modified unless they explicitly ask, because Microsoft Store association tooling manages those files and unintended edits block creating new Store packages.
- Test changes locally before committing or pushing to GitHub; do not commit or push automatically after making changes; wait for explicit go-ahead.
